title: Field boundaries for Austria
description:
**Field boundaries for Austria - INVEKOS Referenzen Österreich 2021.**

The layer includes all reference parcels ("Referenzparzellen") defined by the paying agency Agrarmarkt Austria and recorded landscape elements (landscape element layers) within the meaning of Art. 5 of Regulation (EU) No. 640/2014 and Regulation of the competent federal ministry with horizontal rules for the area of the Common Agricultural Policy (Horizontal CAP Regulation) StF: Federal Law Gazette II No. 100/2015.

Reference parcel: is the physical block that can be clearly delimited from the outside (e.g. forest, roads, water bodies) and is formed by contiguous agricultural areas that are recognizable in nature.

This collection holds 1 edition (2021), one GeoParquet file per year under `year=<year>/` (hive layout). Read them all at once with the partition glob `s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/at_block/year=*/*.parquet` (S3 through the Source Cooperative proxy, endpoint `https://data.source.coop`; plain https cannot expand `*`); the `data` asset is a copy of the latest edition (2021). Geometries are kept in the source CRS (EPSG:31287). Converted with [fiboa-cli](https://github.com/fiboa/cli) into the [fiboa](https://github.com/fiboa/specification) schema; tested queries are in the collection's [AGENTS.md](https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/at_block/AGENTS.md).

table:columns.name: referenz_kennung
table:columns.description: Carried over from the source column `REFERENZ_KENNUNG`; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

table:columns.name: ref_art_bezeichnung
table:columns.description: Carried over from the source column `REF_ART_BEZEICHNUNG`; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: A geometry that reflects the footprint of the field, usually a Polygon. Stored in the source CRS (see `proj:code`), not reprojected. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: inspire:id
table:columns.description: INSPIRE-compliant ID, an absolute and fully resolvable URI. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/inspire-extension/blob/main/README.md))

table:columns.name: metrics:area
table:columns.description: Area of the field, in square meters (m²). Must be > 0 and <= 1,000,000,000. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: ref_art
table:columns.description: Carried over from the source column `REF_ART`; the publisher documents no meaning for it.

table:columns.name: determination:datetime
table:columns.description: The last timestamp at which the field did exist and was observed. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: The bounding box of the field. Per-feature covering column (GeoParquet 1.1), in the source CRS. ([spec](https://github.com/fiboa/specification/blob/main/core/README.md))

partition:keys.name: year
partition:keys.description: Edition year of the source dataset (the converter variant). Not a column in the files; DuckDB adds it with hive_partitioning=true. Expand the glob through S3 (endpoint data.source.coop, path style); plain https has no listing.

data.title: Austria (parcels) — latest edition (2021) (GeoParquet)
data.description: Byte-identical copy of `year=2021/at_block.parquet`, kept at a stable path so `*/latest/*.parquet` selects the newest edition of every collection.

style-field-size.title: Field size (ha)
style-field-size.description: Fields shaded light to dark by area in hectares (metrics:area / 10 000). Stops at 0.1, 0.5, 2 ha, the nice values nearest this dataset's 20th/40th/60th/80th percentiles so each class holds a similar share of fields.

style-outline.title: Field boundaries
style-outline.description: Every field in one colour with a thin outline; for reading the boundaries themselves.
